Software Engineer - Contract (Remote, Latin America)

Integral Stack

Países permitidosLATAM, México
Modalidad100% Remote (GMT-11:00 to GMT-05:00)
Idioma requeridoEnglish (Full professional proficiency)
Experiencia3+ years in microservices, distributed systems, or data engineering
Salario$20 to $40 USD/hour (~$389 to $777 MXN/hour)

Descripción del puesto

Join Integral Stack's LatAm engineering contractor network for long-term engagements (up to 40 hrs/week) building microservices, distributed systems, and data pipelines.

Funciones principales

  • Build and maintain microservices, distributed systems, or data engineering solutions.
  • Extract and transform data from multiple sources, including third-party APIs.
  • Work autonomously while collaborating with a small, quality-focused engineering team.

Requisitos

  • 3+ years of experience in microservices, distributed systems, or data engineering.
  • Proficiency with Node.js or Python (Go, Java, or Rust are also valuable).
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Beneficios

  • Competitive hourly contract rate of $20 to $40 USD.
  • Long-term relationships with consistent hours (up to 40 hrs/week when engaged).
  • 100% remote within Latin America timezones.
